log: Review fix (mastermind-live-page, worktree/qf-4, commit e716dfa63): root cause for both review findings was v1/Live.css loading globally the moment any /live/ page opens (LivePage.pages_of dynamic-imports archive/'s and sessions/' page.js just for their title, and those extend v1's Live class whose View.stylesheet() is never scoped to v1's own pages). v1's .live-card-title{1.25em}/.live-heading{1.5em} share specificity (0,1,0) and layer (site) with LivePage.css's own .live-title/.live-card-title rules, and load after them, so plain source order picked the winner — not my .8rem/1.05rem. Fixed by bumping specificity (.live-title.live-title, .live-card-title.live-card-title), which wins regardless of load order. getComputedStyle probe (headless Playwright, /live/calibration/): BEFORE — h1 24px (v1's 1.5em of 16px), card title 25.2px@400 / 36px@1200 (card bigger, growing with viewport). AFTER — h1 16.8px (its real 1.05rem) and card title 12.8px (its real .8rem) at BOTH 400 and 1200. Also fixed icon_of_title to strip a leftover U+FE0F variation selector (title.replace(/^[️\s]+/, '')) so '⚙️ Page settings...' no longer shows a leading gap. Chevron's padding-bottom tightened 2rem->1.5rem, re-shot at 400/1200, no overlap. Tests: LivePage.test.mjs 44 passed, PageUI.test.mjs 10 assertions, smoke.mjs no FAIL. proof/after-400.png and after-1200.png overwritten with the fixed render.
